cause: The first protocol packet declared a shuffle-target control but did not execute a target permutation through the shared fold-local adapter path.
impact: Consumers could not distinguish an executed negative control from a metadata receipt, weakening the model-evidence boundary.
lesson: A control is evidence only when it runs on the declared exchangeability unit, split manifest and development-only scope; unsupported temporal/panel units must be unavailable rather than row-shuffled.
